principles: One accent for everything clickable. There is no black filled button.
Red is only for elapsing time and failure (recording dot, overdue, processing failure, delete confirmation). Never a button fill.
Status is a 6px dot plus sentence-case text. No filled badges, no pills, no left color bars.
A single radius of 4; control heights 32/40/48; button labels at weight 600.
Secondary actions are text rather than outline, then a faint sunken fill. There is no grey outlined button.
Monospace is only for machine-produced values (time codes, scores, IDs, dates, percentages).
Per-person speech volume and ranking appear nowhere except the subject's own DM (S23).
changelog: 2.1.0 — Added color.*.chart and color.*.waveform ramps, four typography steps (13.5/11.5) and layout widths, all observed in the design files but previously untokenized. Descriptions translated to English.
2.1.1 — Rebuilt color.dark.chart from the dark surface/ink scale so it matches how the light ramp is constructed. The earlier version borrowed waveform values and skipped ink.body.

sunken.$description: Secondary button fill, search input, unselected chips

strong.$description: Titles, emphasized text, inverted band background, confirmed status dot

muted.$description: Meta, section labels, quiet buttons, hollow-ring borders

default.$description: Primary button fill, text buttons, links, active tab underline, checkbox and radio, focus ring, in-progress status dot

selection.$description: Background of a selected row, chip, or sidebar item. No other decoration

attention.$description: Needs a person: unidentified speaker, ambiguous agreement, undecided item, gap MEDIUM, changed decision node

critical.$description: Time and risk: recording, overdue, failure, gap HIGH, deletion. Dots, text, 2px bars and the glow only

confirmed.$description: Confirmed: decisions (hollow ring), commitments and completions (filled dot)

progress.$description: System in progress: analyzing, syncing, linking materials, open question

idle.$description: Hollow-ring border: scheduled, not started, not connected, Phase 2

chart.$description: The only fills permitted in charts and heatmaps — five achromatic steps, low to high. Signal colors never fill a chart; they appear on numeric text only. The ramp is not a separate palette: it is the surface/ink scale (sunken → muted → body → strong) with one intermediate step added between sunken and muted.

step2.$description: The one value in the ramp that is not another token

waveform.$description: Audio waveform bar fill by amplitude, quiet to loud. Bars are 3–4px wide with a 2–3px gap, aligned to the baseline.

dark.$description: A user preference. It does not signify any functional state. The accent fill is identical to light.

text.$description: Lightened indigo for text buttons, links and the active tab underline only (6.2:1)

chart.$description: Built the same way as the light ramp: sunken → intermediate → muted → body → strong. Four of the five steps are existing dark tokens, so no dark analytics screen is needed to define them. Only step2 is a judgment call — it reuses waveform.q1, which sits at the same relative position between sunken and muted that #C9CCD1 occupies in light.

step2.$description: = waveform.q1. The only chosen value; revisit if a dark dashboard ever gets drawn

waveform.$description: Observed in the dark examples on S10, S14 and S33. Bars are 3px wide there.

mono.$description: Time codes, scores, IDs, dates and percentages only

heading.$description: Card titles, top bar, section headings

rowTitle.$description: List row and card item titles — the most common title size in the app

rowBody.$description: Slack message body, quotation body, longer row descriptions

metaSmall.$description: Timestamps and secondary meta beneath a row

label.$description: Section labels. Sentence case; never uppercase or letter-spaced

dataSmall.$description: Sidebar counts, inline counts, tab counts

row.$description: Vertical padding of a list row

radius.$description: Buttons, inputs, cards, modals and tooltips all share it

dot.$description: Status dot. A decision is a 7px hollow ring with a 1.5px border

bar.$description: Thickness of a data bar (gap score, progress)

error.$description: Invalid input; always paired with a message below

glow.$description: A top-level pointer-events:none overlay on the window, independent of theme. When paused, the animation stops and the line becomes rgba(22,25,31,.2). Under prefers-reduced-motion it is a static 2px line

dot.$description: REC dot, synchronized with the glow
